ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with high-intensity (white) spots accounting for approximately 5-8% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark base pigmentation with irregular white punctate mottling localized in the lower third and central regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a sharp vertex angle; notch depth reaches approximately 12-15% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with variable pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys spanning the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve along the posterior margins of the lobes, tapering to sharp lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of small, high-intensity white circular marks located medially on the left lobe and lower-center on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Scattered punctate hypopigmentation (white scars) across the dark surface; irregular serrated profile on the terminal tips of both lobes.
